subject.title: feat(control-ui): add cron calendar timeline view

question: Should maintainers sponsor a repaired 24-hour Cron Jobs timeline as the accepted first slice of the open cron calendar request, or close/pause this stale conflicting branch?
rationale: The branch implements a useful but partial feature, and the remaining work includes both product scope and a broad rebase into the current Control UI architecture; automation should not choose that direction alone.

options.title: Repair Narrow Timeline First
options.body: Rebase this branch or a replacement onto current `ui/src/pages/cron`, fix the status/scheduler/i18n blockers, and treat the 24-hour strip as an intentional first product slice.

options.title: Pause For Full Calendar Design
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open, pause this branch, and decide daily/week/editing requirements before accepting implementation.

options.title: Close This Branch
options.body: Close this stale conflicting PR and invite a fresh narrow PR if maintainers still want the timeline feature.

recommendation.title: Repair Narrow Timeline First
recommendation.body: Rebase this branch or a replacement onto current `ui/src/pages/cron`, fix the status/scheduler/i18n blockers, and treat the 24-hour strip as an intentional first product slice.
